user.title: New irrigation schedule
user.description: Choose how to start. Imports and descriptions only fill in the setup steps; you review every step before anything is saved.

name.title: Schedule name
name.description: Name this schedule. It becomes the device name for the schedule's entities.{notes}

import_legacy.title: Import legacy helpers

import_bhyve.title: Copy a B-Hyve program

describe.title: Describe the schedule
describe.description: Describe the schedule in plain words, for example "water the garden bed valve for 20 minutes every Monday and Thursday at 6am, skip if it rained". The AI task fills in the setup steps, and you review each one.

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: Pick the valves or switches this schedule waters.

data_description.zones: Valve or switch entities. Zones that support a native run time (B-Hyve, Rachio) are started with it.

data_description.zone_mode: Zones on the same Rachio controller can only run one at a time.

frequency.title: Frequency
frequency.description: Choose how the watering days are picked.

interval.title: Every X days
interval.description: Waters on the first run date and every X days after it. Skipped runs do not shift later runs.

weekdays.title: Days of the week
weekdays.description: Pick the days this schedule waters.

start_time.title: Fixed start time
start_time.description: Watering starts at this local time.

start_sunrise.title: Finish by sunrise
start_sunrise.description: Watering finishes this many minutes before sunrise. A negative number finishes after sunrise. The start time is worked out from the total run time.

start_sunset.title: Finish by sunset
start_sunset.description: Watering finishes this many minutes before sunset. A negative number finishes after sunset. The start time is worked out from the total run time.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: Optional checks made at each start time. Leave empty to always water on schedule.

data_description.stale_hours: Ignore the temperature sensor's reading if it hasn't reported for this many hours (0 = off). Doesn't apply to rain, wind or moisture sensors, which don't report while their value stays the same.

rain.title: Recent rain
rain.description: Skip the run when the rain sensors measured at least the threshold during the look-back window.

data.rain_delay_auto_hours: Rain delay after a rain skip (hours)
data.rain_delay_mirror: Copy rain delays to the device
data.rain_stop_during_run: Stop a run when rain starts

data_description.rain_sensors: Precipitation total sensors, for example a weather station rain counter. Pick more than one to combine stations.
data_description.rain_threshold: In the rain sensors' unit (for example inches or mm).
data_description.rain_quorum: Only used when combining by number of stations: this many stations must measure at least the threshold.
data_description.rain_max_hours: Only used with "since the last watering": the look-back never goes further back than this.
data_description.rain_delay_auto_hours: After a run is skipped for rain, pause the schedule for this many hours. 0 turns this off.
data_description.rain_delay_mirror: Also sets the rain delay on B-Hyve devices that have one. Rachio is not supported.
data_description.rain_stop_amount: Only used when stopping on rain: how much a rain sensor must rise after the run starts, in the sensor's unit.

forecast.title: Rain forecast
forecast.description: Skip the run when the weather forecast for the look-ahead window shows rain.

data_description.forecast_probability: Not used when the check is the rain amount only.
data_description.forecast_amount: Total forecast rain over the look-ahead window, in Home Assistant's precipitation unit. Not used when the check is the chance of rain only.
data_description.forecast_quorum: The run is skipped when at least this many weather entities forecast rain. Must not be more than the number of weather entities.

moisture.title: Soil moisture
moisture.description: The soil counts as dry when any selected sensor reads below the threshold.

data.moisture_unavailable: When no sensor has a reading

data_description.moisture_unavailable: Only used in the first mode. In the second mode a missing reading never adds a run.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Skip the run when it is too cold or too hot.

data.weather_entities: Weather entities for the forecast low

data_description.temperature_sensor: Needed for the maximum temperature, which is checked against the current reading.
data_description.temperature_min: Skip when the current reading or the forecast low is at or below this. In the sensor's unit, or Home Assistant's unit when no sensor is picked.
data_description.temperature_max: Skip when the current reading is at or above this.
data_description.temperature_forecast_hours: How far ahead to look for the forecast low. 0 uses the current reading only.
data_description.weather_entities: Only asked when the rain forecast condition is off; otherwise its weather entities are used.

wind.title: Wind
wind.description: Skip the run when the average wind speed is at or above the maximum.

data_description.wind_minutes: The wind speed is averaged over this many minutes. 0 uses the current reading.

occupancy.title: Occupancy
occupancy.description: Hold off watering while someone is in the yard.

data.occupancy_action: When occupied at the start time
data.occupancy_stop_during_run: Stop a run when someone is detected

data_description.occupancy_entities: Binary sensors, input booleans or switches. Any of them being on counts as occupied, for example a camera's person sensor.
data_description.occupancy_max_delay_minutes: Only used when waiting: after this many minutes of occupancy the run is skipped.

ai.title: AI report
ai.description: Optional. Leave the AI task empty to turn these settings off. Nothing is sent to an AI service unless an AI task is picked.

data_description.ai_report_weekday: Pick both a day and a time for a weekly report, or neither.
data_description.ai_camera_entity: Optional. A snapshot is checked for lawn health with LLM Vision and added to the report.
data_description.ai_llmvision_provider: Needed when a camera is picked.

bhyve_disable.title: Turn off the device program
bhyve_disable.description: The schedule is ready to save. The B-Hyve device still has its own program ({switch}), which would water the same zone again. Tick the box to turn that program off.

data.disable_program: Turn off this program on the device

error.rain_threshold_invalid: Enter a rain threshold of at least 0.01.

error.moisture_threshold_invalid: Enter a moisture threshold between 1 and 100.
error.no_rain_sensors: Pick at least one rain sensor.
error.rain_quorum_invalid: Enter a number of stations between 1 and 20.
error.rain_stop_amount_invalid: Enter a rain amount of at least 0.01 to stop a run.
error.no_weather_entities: Pick at least one weather entity.
error.forecast_amount_invalid: Enter a forecast rain amount of at least 0.01.
error.forecast_quorum_invalid: Enter a number between 1 and the number of weather entities.
error.temperature_limit_required: Enter a minimum temperature, a maximum temperature, or both.
error.temperature_range_invalid: The minimum temperature must be below the maximum temperature.
error.temperature_max_needs_sensor: A maximum temperature needs a temperature sensor, because it is checked against the current reading.
error.temperature_source_required: Pick a temperature sensor, or weather entities with forecast hours above 0.
error.wind_max_invalid: Enter a wind speed of at least 0.1.
error.no_occupancy_entities: Pick at least one occupancy entity.
error.ai_report_incomplete: Pick both a report day and a report time, or neither.
error.ai_provider_required: Pick an LLM Vision provider to use a camera.

options.temperature: Skip when too cold or too hot
options.occupancy: Wait or skip while someone is in the yard

options.skip: Only water on schedule days when a sensor is below the threshold
options.trigger: Water on schedule days, and on any other day when a sensor is below the threshold

options.max: Any sensor at or above the threshold
options.median: Median of the sensors at or above the threshold
options.quorum: A number of stations at or above the threshold

options.either: Chance of rain or rain amount
options.both: Chance of rain and rain amount

options.delay: Wait until clear, up to the longest delay

entry_not_found.message: No irrigation schedule has config entry ID {config_entry_id}.

entry_not_loaded.message: The irrigation schedule {name} is not loaded.

ai_not_configured.message: {name} has no AI task set. Pick one in the schedule's AI report settings.

run_now.name: Run now
run_now.description: Starts a schedule's zones now, ignoring its conditions and any pending skip.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Runs every zone for this many minutes instead of its configured run time.

skip_next.name: Skip next run
skip_next.description: Skips the schedule's next run that would water, or cancels a pending skip.

skip.name: Skip
skip.description: On skips the next run. Off cancels a pending skip.

set_rain_delay.name: Set rain delay
set_rain_delay.description: Pauses a schedule's automatic runs for a number of hours. 0 clears the delay.

hours.name: Hours
hours.description: How long to delay. 0 clears an active delay.

run_zone.name: Run zone
run_zone.description: Runs one zone of a schedule now, ignoring its conditions.

config_entry_id.name: Schedule
config_entry_id.description: The irrigation schedule the zone belongs to.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: The valve or switch to run. It must be one of the schedule's zones.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long to run. Defaults to the zone's configured run time.

set_enabled.name: Set enabled
set_enabled.description: Turns a schedule's automatic runs on or off. An active run is not stopped.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: On allows automatic runs. Off stops them.

evaluate.name: Check conditions now
evaluate.description: Returns what the schedule would do if it ran now, without watering or changing anything.

get_history.name: Get history
get_history.description: Returns the schedule's recent runs and skips, newest first.

pause_all.name: Pause all
pause_all.description: Pauses automatic runs on every irrigation schedule. Active runs keep going.

resume_all.name: Resume all
resume_all.description: Resumes automatic runs on every paused irrigation schedule.

stop_all.name: Stop all
stop_all.description: Stops the active run on every irrigation schedule.

generate_report.name: Generate report
generate_report.description: Asks the schedule's AI task for a watering report and returns the text.

config_entry_id.name: Schedule
config_entry_id.description: The irrigation schedule to report on.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days of history to include.

explain_skips.name: Explain skips
explain_skips.description: Asks the schedule's AI task to explain recent skipped runs and returns the text.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days of history to include.
